title: OpenStax Algebra and Trigonometry 2e, 4.3 Fitting Linear Models to Data: Draw and interpret scatter diagrams.
summary: OpenStax Algebra and Trigonometry 2e, 4.3 Fitting Linear Models to Data: Draw and interpret scatter diagrams.
body: OpenStax Algebra and Trigonometry 2e, section "4.3 Fitting Linear Models to Data", prints these objectives: "Draw and interpret scatter diagrams." "Use a graphing utility to find the line of best fit." "Distinguish between linear and nonlinear relations." "Fit a regression line to a set of data and use the linear model to make predictions.". The section text says: "A professor is attempting to identify trends among final exam scores. His class has a mixture of students, so he wonders if there is any relationship between age and final exam scores. One way for him to analyze the scores is by creating a diagram that relates the age of each student to the exam score received. In this section, we will examine one such diagram known as a scatter plot." This card reports that page. The objectives are the book's learning statements, not a separate proof.
